Previewing a pull request's feature files on GitHub Pages
A push is not a pull request

An opened pull request gets its preview, and a comment with its address
A comment that cannot be written stops the action
A closed pull request's preview is removed, and its comment says so
changed-only shows only the feature files the pull request changes
changed-only with no file of the input folder changed publishes nothing
changed-only with no feature file changed leaves the earlier preview as it is
A preview whose sources have not changed is not built again
A preview whose sources changed is built again
A preview's title is the configuration file's, naming the pull request
The input title wins over the configuration file's
Without a title or a configuration file, ghg's own title names the pull request
